skill.name: generate-image
skill.description: Generate or edit general-purpose images with OpenRouter models such as Gemini and FLUX. Use it for photos, illustrations, visual assets, concept art, and image modifications, not technical diagrams.
skill.summary: Generate and edit general-purpose images with OpenRouter image models.
skill.author: davila7

security_audit.summary: The skill has legitimate but meaningful risk because it sends prompts, optional input images, and an API key to OpenRouter. It also reads .env files from the current and parent directories and writes output to a caller-selected path. Most SKILL.md external-command detections are Markdown examples, not executable backtick usage.

remediation.issue: Automatic parent-directory .env discovery can use credentials outside the active project.
remediation.suggestion: Read only an explicit .env path or the process environment, and ask for confirmation before using discovered credentials.

remediation.issue: Prompts and input images are sent to OpenRouter.
remediation.suggestion: Add clear privacy disclosure and require user confirmation before sending sensitive images or private prompts.

remediation.issue: The output path is user-controlled and may overwrite local files.
remediation.suggestion: Refuse existing files unless an overwrite flag is provided, and constrain default output to a safe working directory.

remediation.issue: API keys may be supplied through command-line arguments.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer environment variables or a secure credential store, and warn users that command-line secrets can be logged.

content.value_statement: Creating visual assets usually requires switching tools and rewriting prompts. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code generate or edit images through OpenRouter models.
actual_capabilities: Generates new images from text prompts with OpenRouter image models.
Edits an existing local image when an input path is provided.
Supports Gemini and FLUX model identifiers documented by the skill.
Saves returned base64 image data to a local PNG file.
Lets users choose model, output path, input path, and API key source.
limitations: Requires an OpenRouter API key and the requests Python package.
Sends prompts and input images to OpenRouter for processing.
Does not create technical diagrams; use scientific-schematics for those.
Output quality, speed, and cost depend on the selected external model.

use_cases.title: Create Presentation Visuals
use_cases.description: Generate backgrounds, concept images, and supporting visuals for slides or posters.

use_cases.title: Produce Product Concepts
use_cases.description: Create quick visual concepts for product ideas, campaigns, and design reviews.

use_cases.title: Edit Existing Images
use_cases.description: Modify a local image with a clear editing prompt and save the result as a new file.

prompt_templates.title: Generate a Simple Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate an image of [subject] in [style] with [key details]. Save it as [file name].

prompt_templates.title: Create a Presentation Asset
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a professional image for a slide about [topic]. Use [tone], [colors], and [format]. Save it to [path].

prompt_templates.title: Edit a Local Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Edit [input image path] by [specific changes]. Keep [elements to preserve]. Save the result as [output path].

prompt_templates.title: Build a Campaign Visual
prompt_templates.prompt: Create [asset type] using [model name]. Follow this brief: [audience, composition, lighting, brand constraints]. Save it as [output path].

output_examples.input: Prompt for an abstract background for a sales deck.
output_examples.output: A PNG file saved locally, with status messages showing the selected model and output path.

output_examples.input: Request to edit a portrait by changing the background color.
output_examples.output: A new edited image file that preserves the subject and applies the requested background change.

output_examples.input: Brief for a science poster hero image.
output_examples.output: A generated visual asset suitable for layout review, subject to model quality and usage rights.

best_practices: Confirm external API use before processing private images.
Use specific prompts with subject, style, composition, and output location.
Store OpenRouter keys securely and avoid sharing secrets in prompts.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill for flowcharts, circuit diagrams, or exact technical schematics.
Do not send confidential images unless OpenRouter use is approved.
Do not pass API keys in places that may be logged or shared.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates or edits general-purpose images such as photos, illustrations, artwork, and presentation visuals.

faq.question: What API key is required?
faq.answer: It requires an OpenRouter API key for image generation and editing requests.

faq.question: Can it edit existing images?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide an input image path and clear editing instructions.

faq.question: Where are images saved?
faq.answer: The script saves output to the requested path or to generated_image.png by default.

faq.question: Does it work offline?
faq.answer: No. It sends requests to OpenRouter and needs network access.

faq.question: Should I use it for diagrams?
faq.answer: No. Use a diagram-focused skill for flowcharts, schematics, and exact technical drawings.
